newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's foreign reserves rise to $15.64 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's foreign reserves rise to $15.64 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $111 million, or 0.7 percent, to $15.64 billion in the week to Feb 7, according to figures released by the Central Bank Monday.
Reserves were up from $15.529 bln on Feb 3, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $411 million, or 2.7 percent.
The reserve figures' release was delayed from its usual Friday announcement due to the Carnival holiday last week, a Central Bank spokeswoman said.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
